name: CRM
description: For a small sales team: leads (capture, qualify, convert to an account, a contact and an opportunity), opportunities with stages, expected value and close date, quotes with lines and a printable quotation (no tax computed), activities on each deal's timeline, email and WhatsApp touchpoints, a sales pipeline dashboard (by stage, by owner, won and lost, forecast by month), a desktop app and a phone app for reps, flows for new leads, stale deals, big discounts (manager approval) and won or lost deals, and three roles (sales rep with own rows, sales manager with the team's rows, viewer). Accounts, contacts, products and price lists come from the common business model. Stages, lead sources and loss reasons are reference rows; SAMPLE rows of fictional deals are optional.

slots.label: Accounts (common business model)
slots.description: The organisations you sell to: the Accounts of the common business model, shared with other packs.

slots.label: Products (common business model)
slots.description: What you sell: the Products of the common business model.

slots.label: Price lists (common business model)
slots.description: Price lists of the common business model.

slots.label: Price list items (common business model)
slots.description: The price of a product in a price list.

slots.label: Lead sources
slots.description: Where leads come from (reference rows; change them to your own).

create.name: LeadSources
create.description: Where leads come from (reference rows; change them to your own).

slots.label: Loss reasons
slots.description: Why an opportunity was lost (reference rows; change them to your own).

create.name: LossReasons
create.description: Why an opportunity was lost (reference rows; change them to your own).

slots.label: Sales stages
slots.description: The stages of an opportunity with the probability of winning at each (reference rows). The probability of an opportunity follows its stage.

create.name: SalesStages
create.description: The stages of an opportunity with the probability of winning at each (reference rows). The probability of an opportunity follows its stage.

slots.label: Opportunities
slots.description: Deals in progress: stage, expected value, close date and the weighted amount (value x probability of the stage).

create.name: Opportunities
create.description: Deals in progress: stage, expected value, close date and the weighted amount (value x probability of the stage).

events.name: Probability from the stage; closed date
events.actions: If(!IsBlank(LookUp(Slot_SalesStages, Slot_SalesStages_Name = New.Slot_Opportunities_Stage)), SetField({Slot_Opportunities_Probability: LookUp(Slot_SalesStages, Slot_SalesStages_Name = New.Slot_Opportunities_Stage).Slot_SalesStages_Probability})); If((New.Slot_Opportunities_Stage = "Won" || New.Slot_Opportunities_Stage = "Lost") && IsBlank(New.Slot_Opportunities_ClosedOn), SetField({Slot_Opportunities_ClosedOn: Today()}))

events.name: A lost deal has a reason
events.message: Choose the loss reason before marking the opportunity Lost.

events.name: Value is not negative
events.message: The expected value cannot be negative.

slots.label: Leads
slots.description: People and companies that may become customers: capture, qualify, then convert to an account, a contact and an opportunity (set the status Converted).

create.name: Leads
create.description: People and companies that may become customers: capture, qualify, then convert to an account, a contact and an opportunity (set the status Converted).

events.name: A way to reach the lead
events.message: A qualified or converted lead needs an email address or a phone number.

slots.label: Quotes
slots.description: Commercial quotes for an opportunity: lines, a header discount, the total. No tax is computed on a quote. A discount above 10% needs a sales manager's approval before the quote is sent.

create.name: Quotes
create.description: Commercial quotes for an opportunity: lines, a header discount, the total. No tax is computed on a quote. A discount above 10% needs a sales manager's approval before the quote is sent.

events.name: Account and price list
events.actions: If(IsBlank(New.Slot_Quotes_Account) && !IsBlank(New.Slot_Quotes_Opportunity), SetField({Slot_Quotes_Account: LookUp(Slot_Opportunities, id = New.Slot_Quotes_Opportunity).Slot_Opportunities_Account})); If(IsBlank(New.Slot_Quotes_PriceList) && !IsBlank(LookUp(Slot_PriceLists, Slot_PriceLists_IsDefault = true)), SetField({Slot_Quotes_PriceList: LookUp(Slot_PriceLists, Slot_PriceLists_IsDefault = true).id}))

events.name: Discount between 0 and 100

events.name: Valid until after the quote date

events.message: A discount above 10% needs the sales manager's approval before the quote is sent. Save the quote as Draft and wait for the approval.

slots.label: Quote lines
slots.description: The products on a quote: quantity and unit price (from the quote's price list, else the product's standard price).

create.name: QuoteLines
create.description: The products on a quote: quantity and unit price (from the quote's price list, else the product's standard price).

events.name: Description and price from the product
events.actions: If(IsBlank(New.Slot_QuoteLines_UnitPrice) && !IsBlank(New.Slot_QuoteLines_Product), SetField({Slot_QuoteLines_UnitPrice: Coalesce(LookUp(Slot_PriceListItems, Slot_PriceListItems_Product = New.Slot_QuoteLines_Product && Slot_PriceListItems_PriceList = New.Slot_QuoteLines_PriceList).Slot_PriceListItems_UnitPrice, LookUp(Slot_Products, id = New.Slot_QuoteLines_Product).Slot_Products_StandardPrice)})); If(IsBlank(New.Slot_QuoteLines_Description) && !IsBlank(New.Slot_QuoteLines_Product), SetField({Slot_QuoteLines_Description: LookUp(Slot_Products, id = New.Slot_QuoteLines_Product).Slot_Products_Name}))

events.name: Quantity and price
events.message: The quantity must be more than zero and the price cannot be negative.

apps.name: Sales on the go
apps.description: Reps on a phone: my open deals, log a call or a meeting in a few taps, update a stage, look up an account with its deals and people; works offline (entry).

props.OnSelect: =If(IsBlank(LogSubject.Value), Notify("Write a subject first", NotificationType.Warning), Patch(Activities, Defaults(Activities), {Type: varLogType, Subject: LogSubject.Value, Description: LogNotes.Value, Status: "Done", regardingId: varDeal.id, StartOn: Now()}); Reset(LogSubject); Reset(LogNotes); Notify("Logged on the deal", NotificationType.Success); Back())

flows.name: New lead: tell the owner and the managers
flows.description: A new lead notifies its owner (the person who captured it) and the sales managers.

steps.name: TellOwner
steps.title: "New lead: " & Trigger.Record.Slot_Leads_Name
steps.body: Coalesce(Trigger.Record.Slot_Leads_Company, "") & " · " & Coalesce(Text(Trigger.Record.Slot_Leads_EstimatedValue), "no estimate") & ". Qualify it in the Sales app."

flows.name: Convert a lead
flows.description: A lead whose status becomes Converted gets an account (an existing one with the same name is reused), a contact and an opportunity, all owned by the lead's owner, once; the lead links to them.

steps.name: TellOwner
steps.title: "Lead converted: " & Trigger.Record.Slot_Leads_Name
steps.body: "An account, a contact and an opportunity were created. Open the Pipeline in the Sales app."

flows.name: Stale opportunity reminder
flows.description: Every working day at 09:00 (India time) each open opportunity that has not changed for 14 days gets a follow-up task for its owner (one open reminder per opportunity).

steps.name: AlreadyAsked
steps.if: CountRows(Filter(Activities, regardingId = Opp.id && Category = "Stale reminder" && Status = "Open")) = 0

values.Subject: "Follow up: " & Opp.Slot_Opportunities_Name & " has not moved for 14 days"
values.Description: "Stage " & Opp.Slot_Opportunities_Stage & ". Log a call or a meeting, or move the stage."

flows.name: Quote discount approval
flows.description: A quote with a discount above 10% (and above what was approved before) is marked Pending and asked of the sales managers on behalf of the rep who owns it; the answer is written back and the rep is told. Until approved the quote cannot be set to Sent.

flows.name: Keep the quote subtotal
flows.description: When a quote line is added, changed or deleted, the subtotal of its quote is recalculated (the discount amount and the total follow). Switch it on with the other flows; the printed quote always sums the lines itself.

flows.name: Won or lost: tell the owner and the managers
flows.description: An opportunity that becomes Won or Lost notifies its owner and the sales managers (with the loss reason).

flows.name: Send and log a touchpoint
flows.description: A new touchpoint (email or WhatsApp to the contact of an opportunity) is logged as an activity on the opportunity. An email is sent through the environment's email connection when there is one; without a connection, or when the send fails, the touchpoint is marked Not sent and the run still succeeds. WhatsApp is logged only: Appbuilder sends nothing from this flow (see the CRM pack page for adding a WhatsApp connection).

values.Slot_Touchpoints_Result: "Not sent: no email connection, no email address for the contact, or the send failed. Logged on the timeline."
"Logged only: Appbuilder did not send this WhatsApp message."

approvalPolicies.name: Quote discount
approvalPolicies.description: A sales manager approves a quote whose discount is above 10%; the rep who made the quote is never asked. A reminder after 8 hours, due in two days.

def.title: Sales pipeline
def.description: Open pipeline, weighted forecast, won value, win rate, by stage, by owner, won and lost, and the forecast by month. Each person sees the rows their role allows: a rep their own, a manager the team's.

printTemplates.name: Quote
printTemplates.description: A commercial quotation with its lines, the discount and the total; no tax is computed and the document says so.

body.text: *Amounts are in Indian rupees. No tax has been computed on this quotation; any applicable taxes are added when the invoice is made.*

roles.name: Sales rep
roles.description: Works their own leads, accounts, contacts, opportunities, quotes and touchpoints (own rows only); reads products, price lists and the reference lists. Cannot change a quote's discount approval.

roles.name: Sales manager
roles.description: Sees and works the rows of their team (the people in the same teams), approves quotes with a big discount, keeps the lead sources, loss reasons and stages.

roles.name: Sales viewer
roles.description: Reads the whole pipeline, quotes and accounts (for management and finance); changes nothing.

sequences.name: Quotes
sequences.description: Quote numbers (restart each financial year, April to March).
